title: BrightWave renewal triage — AE 1:1 prep
content:
Context / objective:
- Quick prep for 1:1 with Tara (AE) before customer sync on 2026-03-15. Primary goal: lock renewal timeline + identify one low-friction upsell (analytics add-on) and remove blockers for legal review. Secondary: align on support backlog triage and open escalation items.

Customer at a glance (BrightWave Media):
- ARR: $420k current year (net of platform discounts)
- Renewal: 2026-04-10 (contract end) — high priority
- Usage: average tokens/day 1.2M (down 8% last 30 days) — weekly active routes: 6
- Open tickets: 3 active (1 P2 latency, 2 P3 feature requests)
- Recent incidents: 2026-02-28 9:42am PST — 90s tail-latency spike affecting preview API (root cause: autoscaler tuning), mitigated via manual scale-up.
- CS health score: 72 (green->amber borderline)

Recent signals to note:
- Product team shipped minor SDK fix (v1.3.4) on 2026-03-02; BrightWave reported faster startup in staging but hasn’t promoted to prod.
- Finance flagged planned headcount freeze for Q2 — may impact negotiation room.
- AE notes: champion (Maya Chen, Head of AI) is optimistic but wants detailed latency SLO + cost projection.

Key risks / red flags to bring up:
1) Legal turnaround time (previous renewal took 21 business days) — need escalation path to hit 2026-04-10.
2) Usage dip — could indicate migration to competitor A for some batch workflows. Need to surface churn risk early.
3) Latency incident sensitivity — marketing team uses real-time previews; another incident could push them to reconsider.

Proposed agenda for 1:1 with Tara (15–20 min):
- 2 min: quick status & mutual priorities
- 5 min: renewal timeline and legal path (who to escalate to on legal side)
- 5 min: technical follow-ups (P2 incident mitigation + SDK promotion plan)
- 5–8 min: upsell opportunity (analytics add-on) + pricing anchor and next steps

Talking points / suggested phrasing for customer call (short scripts):
- Renewal urgency: "We want to make this as frictionless as possible — what's the single biggest blocker from your side to getting the new order signed by 2026-04-10?"
- Latency reassurance: "We traced the 2/28 spike to autoscaler config; we've scheduled a targeted tuning + an automated guardrail to avoid recurrence. Happy to share the tuning plan and a short post-mortem."
- Upsell intro: "Based on your usage patterns, the analytics add-on should cut analysis time by ~40% and reduce operator effort. If you’re open, we can run a 30-day trial on a subset of routes."

Technical notes to surface (for Tara to coordinate with Eng):
- Suggested SLOs to propose: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 240ms for preview endpoints; sustained throughput target 4k rps across pool.
- Action needed: eng to confirm autoscaler guardrail ticket + ETA. Ticket: RW-5821 (assigned to infra).
- SDK: confirm patch v1.3.4 has full backwards compat; ask devx to prepare a short upgrade doc for BrightWave (one-pager).

Negotiation / pricing playbook idea (simple):
- Anchor on renewal at current effective rate for 12 months if signed by 2026-04-10; offer analytics add-on trial for 30 days free, then +8% ARR if accepted.
- If they push discount, offer one-time CO term credit instead of lowering unit price.

Action items (clear, single-line, owner, due date):
1) Tara — Confirm legal contact at BrightWave and request draft PO form by 2026-03-17.
2) Ravi — Prep cost impact breakdown for analytics add-on (delta to ARR, ops) by 2026-03-13.
3) Infra (RW-5821 assignee) — Post ETA on autoscaler guardrail changes in ticket by 2026-03-12 (update for customer).
4) DevX (Sophia) — One-page SDK upgrade guide + migration checklist by 2026-03-16.
5) Tara + Ravi — Draft renewal email template for champion review by 2026-03-14.
6) Ravi — Run quick usage anomaly check for 2026-01..2026-03 and share top 3 route drops by 2026-03-13.
7) Tara — Schedule joint sync (AE + CSM + Eng) with BrightWave for week of 2026-03-22.

Notes-to-self / open questions (scratch):
- Who owns escalation to legal on our side? Is it Lauren (legal) or Sam (enterprise AM)? I think Lauren but confirm.
- If they want a longer term discount, prefer to shift to committed capacity rather than unit price cut. Make the capacity math quick.
- Check whether BrightWave is in any current pilot for Dedicated offering — could be a strategic upsell if they need isolation.
- Need to draft short post-mortem language that is non-technical but reassuring for marketing stakeholders.

Meeting prep checklist (quick):
- [ ] Print/update renewal timeline calendar (shared)
- [ ] Attach cost delta spreadsheet in email draft
- [ ] Confirm legal approver names
- [ ] Load SDK guide into Confluence (link to share)
- [ ] Add escalation contact cards for on-call infra lead

Follow-up cadence suggestion after customer call:
- Within 24h: send action-summary email + next steps + dates
- 3–5 business days: legal touchpoint to confirm contract timing
- Weekly until signed: 10–15min cadence with AE+CSM to track blockers

Quick closing note for 1:1:
- Ask Tara: "If I take ownership of the usage deep-dive and a post-mortem blurb, can you lead the PO/legal outreach?" -> Keep ask binary and clear.

Scratch / raw snippets (don’t show to customer):
- "If they push for price cut, offer 12mo commit with 5% discount + analytics trial; avoid multi-year discounts unless committed capacity."
- Unresolved: confirm billing contact (Finance) — Jordan? (check SFDC contact card)

End of prep doc.
